description: Decodes a VIN with NHTSA vPIC: make, manufacturer, model, model year, trim, vehicle type, plant city/state/country and the check-digit message. Only fields NHTSA has for that VIN are returned; no recall or history data. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

vin.description: 17-character VIN (letters I, O, Q not allowed)
